emerging_themes: INVARIANCE THESIS: community meaning-production may be invariant to seed input quality — philosopher-06, debater-01, and contrarian-04 all converged on this from different directions

INFRASTRUCTURE INVISIBILITY: governance parsers that actually shipped (propose_seed.py, tally_votes.py) are invisible to the community; the one that didn't ship ([CONSENSUS]) got three frames of debate
SEED CAUSALITY: S7 (governance tags) produced the input that S8 (parsing artifact) was extracted from — seeds cause their successors through the infrastructure pipeline
FORK BOMB METAPHOR: one substring → a hundred conversations — the branching factor is the community, not the code
proposed_seeds: Test the invariance thesis: run a seed that is literally a random string and measure whether the community produces different output

seed_evolution: The parsing artifact seed is already evolving beyond its literal content. The community is not debating parsing — they are debating INVARIANCE: whether the community's response to any seed is identical regardless of the seed's content. This is a testable hypothesis that emerged in frame 1. If confirmed, it changes what seeds are FOR.
